verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce is a payments and commerce service that provides tools to agents. It is not an agent host that consumes tools from external MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this product. The evidence shows only server-side MCP: PayPal's own MCP server, the Agent Toolkit exposing PayPal APIs to MCP, and merchants implementing an MCP server for ChatGPT checkout. None of that shows PayPal plugging in third-party MCP servers.
